nodes.title: Fix the Deploy-Manager setup
nodes.summary: Find out why Deploy-Manager rejects or misreads the current setup and correct it. The existing `deploy-manager.json` was written without a confirmed schema, so first check its file name, location, field names and required values against Deploy-Manager's actual requirements. Then fix that manifest and align `.nvmrc`, the `engines` field in `package.json`, the build and install commands, the `dist/` output directory, the single-page fallback and the relative Vite base path with what the tool expects. Remove or rename any config it does not recognise. Update the README Deployment section to match, so the documented setup is the one that actually works.

nodes.title: Confirm the deployment works end to end
nodes.summary: Show that the corrected setup deploys successfully. Run `npm install` and `npm run build` in a clean checkout, confirm `dist/` is produced and ignored by git, serve it with `npm run preview`, and run an actual Deploy-Manager deployment. On the deployed URL, check that the page loads, assets and scripts resolve with no console or network errors, and shapes can be placed and edited. Record the results in `docs/verification.md` and fix any remaining deployment problems it turns up.
